title: Active-passive state-resync playbook with staged load-shedding and circuit-breaker testing
text:
Active-passive state-resync playbook with staged load-shedding and circuit-breaker testing

description:
Objective: Create and validate a playbook for active-passive cross-region failover that emphasizes state resynchronization semantics for cache/KV, ordered DB migrations, circuit-breaker exercise, and staged load-shedding. Scope covers: orchestrated failover from primary region A -> passive region B; restore validation of incremental backups; KV/prefix cache replay and consistency checks; traffic ramp and staged shedding to preserve SLOs; verification of circuit-breaker behavior under failure modes; automated and manual rollback paths.

Why this is needed: Current runbooks cover basic failover but do not sufficiently exercise state resync (in-memory KV cache + streaming prefix caches), nor do they validate the interaction between load-shedding policies and our global circuit-breaker. We must ensure failover preserves correctness for transient tokens, ongoing streaming sessions, and named customer reserved capacity. This ticket synthesizes previous DR exercises and expands to include state resynchronization and explicit load-shedding choreography.

Scope exclusions: Full on-prem air-gapped packaging, tenant-level cryptographic key rotations, and non-API admin flows are out of scope for this ticket and will be handled in follow-ups.

Risks and mitigations: Potential for double-processing when switching active write traffic; mitigation includes write-quorum gating, DB write fencing, and synthetic write checks. Risk of degraded SLOs during cache warm-up; mitigation includes staged traffic ramp and prefix-cache prefetch jobs. Risk of incomplete backup validation for large token stores; mitigation includes fast-incremental checksum pass and spot-restore of high-volume partitions.

acceptance_criteria:
A repeatable failover drill runs with documented timeline and roles and completes within the timebox
Passive region accepts writes and completes state resync without data loss for a representative subset (customer+system namespaces)
KV/prefix caches are repopulated to >=90% hit-rate on representative workloads within 15 minutes of failover
Circuit-breaker thresholds trigger expected fallbacks under simulated latency spikes and do not block healthy critical control-plane traffic
Load-shedding policies reduce tail latency impact while keeping P95 generation latency within SLO targets defined below
Backup restore validation includes checksum agreement and application-level sanity checks for 3 representative tenants
All runbook steps have automated validation hooks (dashboards, smoke endpoints, synthetic checks) and a post-run report is generated

expected_metrics:
P95 gen latency <= 250ms during staged ramp (non-degraded targets)
P99 gen latency < 800ms during steady-state in passive region
KV cache hit-rate >= 90% within 15 minutes
No data loss detected in sampled transaction logs (checksum match)
Circuit-breaker open/close transitions logged and matched against expected thresholds
Error budget burn rate during drill < 2x baseline

runbook_steps:
Pre-run checklist (72h): verify recent backups, TTLs, schema migrations published, confirm on-call rotation and PagerDuty escalation matrix
T-2h: Create immutable run id and tag all telemetry dashboards; snapshot current SLO state and usage per-tenant
T-1h: Freeze non-essential background jobs and scheduled batch processes that write to primary data stores
T-30m: Execute synthetic write healthchecks and write-fence preflight to mark active region; publish read-only banner for non-critical UI flows
Failover trigger (manual): flip global traffic routing to passive region B with traffic mirroring enabled for first 5 minutes
State resync phase: run KV replay worker on passive region to ingest incremental WAL segments; run prefix-cache rehydration prefetch for top-10 prefixes
Validation: run checksum comparison for sample partitions, run application-level smoke tests (login, generation, embedding fetch), and verify quota accounting for reserved capacity
Staged load ramp: 0% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% over 20 minutes with automated monitoring gates at each stage; if gates fail, run defined rollback step
Circuit-breaker exercise: inject latency (network emulation) to a dependent service and observe circuit open behavior; verify fallback model variant is selected and request logs show expected reasons
Backup/restore validation (parallel): perform a spot-restore of a high-volume tokenstore partition into an isolated cluster and run end-to-end correctness tests
Post-failover stabilization: keep mirroring from old primary for 30 minutes, continue synthetic traffic for 1 hour; collect logs and trace samples for run id
Rollback: if data divergence or critical SLO breaches, run write-fence and revert global routing to original region following rollback checklist

test_plan:
Create 3 tenant fixtures (small, medium, high throughput) and seed representative data sets
Simulate incremental WAL delivery delays and ensure replay idempotency in passive region
Run KV-cache warming jobs using historical access traces and measure hit-rate curve
Inject API latency and error modes into downstream services to validate circuit-breaker thresholds and fallback correctness
Perform full restore of a recent backup into staging and run end-to-end token validity tests, including streaming session resumes
Run chaos scenario where primary still accepts a small amount of writes (misrouted) and verify fencing prevents double-apply
Automate smoke validation hooks to emit pass/fail events to a dedicated drill dashboard

rollback_plan:
Step 1: Immediately enable write-fence on passive region to prevent further divergence
Step 2: Re-route user-facing traffic to original primary region using run id-scoped routing rule
Step 3: Run reconciliation job to compare transaction logs and queue pending compensating actions
Step 4: Open postmortem channel and notify legal/customer success for any impacted customers
Step 5: Schedule a follow-up targeted restore if sample validation shows missing critical records

Generate automated drill report with timeline, metrics, and reconciliation artifacts
Announce outcomes to SRE, Product, and Customer Success with customer-impact summary
Create follow-up tickets for KV replay parallelization and prefetch optimization
Schedule a 72-hour blameless postmortem and action-tracking board
